rules.title: Paste/Transfer Site Destination
rules.description: Agent-invoked command references a known paste or file-transfer site — a common staging destination.
rules.false_positive_notes: Developers legitimately share snippets; weigh against what data the same session touched.

rules.title: Archive Staging Before Network Activity
rules.description: Agent command aggregates local data into an archive — review for staging preceding a network send.
rules.false_positive_notes: Archiving is routine in builds and backups; only meaningful alongside unexpected destinations.

rules.title: Remote Script Piped to Shell
rules.description: Command downloads remote content and pipes it directly into a shell interpreter.
rules.false_positive_notes: Common in legitimate installers (brew, rustup); verify the source domain.

rules.title: Wildcard Tool Permissions Configured
rules.description: Configuration grants blanket tool permissions (e.g. Bash(*)), removing per-command review.
rules.false_positive_notes: Some teams intentionally allow blanket Bash on sandboxed CI hosts.
